svg.title: Code map views
svg.desc: Four views of the Compound code map on the Hono repository. Impact · url.ts: the Impact view of src/utils/url.ts, its dependents drawn as a graph beside the inspector, which counts 219 dependent files and lists bench.mts and hono.mts from benchmarks/query-param/src first. Trace: the recorded import path from src/hono.ts through the trie router's index.ts and router.ts to node.ts, drawn as four labeled files beside the trace box that spells out the same path. Changed: the Changed view, with context.ts and hono.ts, the two files with uncommitted edits, ringed in amber among the files wired to them; the footer reads 137 files · 319 imports. Source preview: the read-only preview of src/router/smart-router/router.ts (typescript · 70 lines · read from disk), opened at the SmartRouter class on line 4.
